name: wp-ja-kinetic/article-byline-meta
title: Article byline meta
description: `.hx-author__meta` on the single-article byline (`article/default.php:183-193`): role, date and read-time joined into ONE text node with " · " (`implode(' · ', $hxMeta)`) — not three separate elements, so it is built server-side here rather than composed from three block instances.
